boundaries.name: Creative Intelligence & Planner Authority
boundaries.authority: Creative proposal, intent formulation, narrative structure, recipe execution, and capability request generation
forbidden_dependencies: ai.mcp.* (Raw MCP Transport)
subprocess / os.system (Host Shell)
Direct FFmpeg command construction
Direct project filesystem writes
boundaries.verification_method: Automated AST / Regex repository search & Architecture Guard test suite

boundaries.name: Recipes and Skills Decoupling
boundaries.authority: Creative templates, skill workflows, and declarative capability requirements
forbidden_dependencies: Hardcoded provider names as execution authority
Direct MCP transport sessions
Direct local filesystem absolute paths
boundaries.verification_method: JSON Schema recipe validation & Skill source AST audit

boundaries.name: Capability Routing & Classification Seam
boundaries.authority: Sole authoritative dispatch point mapping abstract CapabilityRequest into ModelRouter or ToolGateway
forbidden_dependencies: Direct execution of provider API network calls
Direct execution of native tools bypassing ToolGateway or ModelRouter
boundaries.verification_method: CapabilityRouter category dispatch and catalog completeness tests

boundaries.name: Model Subsystem & Local STT Boundary
boundaries.authority: Deterministic model candidate evaluation, scoring, fallback chains, and SPEECH_TO_TEXT local execution
forbidden_dependencies: audio-tools-mcp (Architectural ownership eliminated in S28-M04)
Direct host filesystem path references in caller contracts
boundaries.verification_method: STT canonical integration and ModelRouter boundary guards

boundaries.name: ToolGateway & Authorization Policy Gate
boundaries.authority: Multi-tenant boundary enforcement, role-based authorization, rate limiting, and tool adapter dispatch
forbidden_dependencies: Bypassing tenant or project access confinement
Executing unauthenticated or untrusted requests
boundaries.verification_method: Multi-tenant adversarial tests and RBAC validation

boundaries.name: Canonical Domain Service Authority
boundaries.authority: Asset status management, media cache, job queue management, and manifest mutations
forbidden_dependencies: ai.mcp.* (Domain services must never depend on compatibility facades)
Arbitrary raw filesystem writes outside StorageService
boundaries.verification_method: Boundary dependency audit and DomainServiceAdapter isolation tests

boundaries.name: Durable Worker & Staging Workspace
boundaries.authority: Heavy media processing execution, FFmpeg/PIL encapsulation, and disposable scratch management
forbidden_dependencies: Retaining permanent state in temporary worker directories
Emitting unverified or unprobed output media
boundaries.verification_method: Worker crash/cleanup simulation and scratch workspace inspection

boundaries.name: Authoritative Heavy Object Storage
boundaries.authority: Canonical source of truth for assets, artifacts, transcripts, renders, and media cache
forbidden_dependencies: Unbounded path traversal (e.g. '../..')
Arbitrary host filesystem access outside storage root
boundaries.verification_method: Storage security guard and traversal rejection tests

boundaries.name: External MCP Compatibility Facade
boundaries.authority: Translates legacy MCP protocol requests from external IDE/editor clients to canonical ToolGateway requests
allowed_callers: External IDE Clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Antigravity)
forbidden_dependencies: Direct canonical state ownership
Bypassing ToolGateway authorization and tenant boundaries
Internal AI caller dependencies on MCP facade
boundaries.verification_method: Dual-path parity tests and MCP offline independence tests

boundaries.name: Canonical Lifecycle & Registry Inviolability
boundaries.authority: Sole authority for project state transitions and capability catalog registration
forbidden_dependencies: Direct mutation from external MCP tools
Direct mutation from internal AI reasoning components
boundaries.verification_method: Lifecycle and registry mutation rejection guards

boundaries.name: Rendering & Quality Control (QC) Authority
boundaries.authority: Rendering orchestration, technical probing, AV sync analysis, black frame detection, and final acceptance gate
forbidden_dependencies: Bypassing final QC checks
Publishing artifacts marked failed by QC
boundaries.verification_method: Final QC gate tests and remediation acceptance proof
